summary: This paper presents a definitive, machine-checked resolution of the Bapat-Sunder conjecture in the rank-2 complex regime. By establishing universal row-sum reduction, CP^1 invariance, and an exact O(n^3) Cauchy-Binet elementary-symmetric-polynomial Gram factorization, the author proves low-dimensional rigidity and circulant AM-GM barriers while exhibiting explicit Gaussian-integer counterexamples at n = 8, 9, and 10. All results are fully formalized in Lean 4 with zero sorry and independently certified via a zero-float Python verifier.
